project.name: Opes HealthCore Starter — Life Sciences Research LIMS & Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN)
project.description: Independent life-sciences research LIMS and Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN) starter: research projects/studies, versioned protocols with Ethics/IRB approval gate, scientific sample registry (donor, organism, cell line, tissue, environmental — zero clinical patient coupling), chain-of-custody transfers, assay instrument runs, and versioned ELN experiment sign-off. Zero MPI/EMR/HIS dependencies.
